meta.originalInput: You're told cortisol is a toxic stress hormone you need to eliminate. But without it, you literally couldn't wake up. Cortisol isn't your enemy—it's your biological energy steering wheel. It mobilizes glucose, sharpens alertness, and regulates blood pressure. The real damage isn't the spike—it's the leak. When stress stays active all day, cortisol receptors desensitize, crushing dopamine and wrecking sleep. Don't suppress cortisol; anchor its rhythm. View direct morning sunlight within twenty minutes of waking, and delay caffeine ninety minutes so your natural peak does its job.
